text: ป่อคิงหยัง
criteria: Rude rhetorical retort involving the listener's father, as documented by cited sources. Not 'What are you doing?' or a greeting. This is the user-reported development regression, not held-out.

text: ป้อคิงหยัง
criteria: Preserve the rude rhetorical retort and kinship reference without invented threats or turning it into an ordinary activity question.

text: จ้วยอู้จ้าๆหน่อยได้ก่อ
criteria: A polite request to speak more slowly, still a question. Related corpus example exists; this is not held-out evidence of model generalization.

text: ป้อเปิ้นไปกาดแล้ว
criteria: Literal father has gone to the market. Do not introduce insults merely because the word father appears.

text: เพื่อนบอกว่า ‘ป้อคิงหยัง’ เป็นคำด่า
criteria: Translate a statement ABOUT a quoted insult; do not directly insult the reader.

text: จ๊องกิ๊งแฟลชป๋อง
criteria: Unfamiliar invented phrase: ask for meaning without fabricated etymology or definitive possibilities.
